title: Topology, Metric Structures and Function Spaces
description: Prerequisite topology, metric completeness, function spaces, and convergence modes (A01-A14)

declarations.name: Topological Space and Neighborhood Basis
declarations.scope_summary: General topological space via open sets and neighborhood bases
declarations.statement_summary: A topology on X is a collection of subsets closed under arbitrary unions and finite intersections.

declarations.name: Subspace, Product and Quotient Topologies
declarations.scope_summary: Constructed topologies on subsets, products, and quotient sets
declarations.statement_summary: Initial topology for projections on product spaces and final topology for canonical quotient projections.

declarations.name: Hausdorff Separation and Countability Axioms
declarations.scope_summary: Hausdorff T2 separation, first and second countability, separability
declarations.statement_summary: Distinct points possess disjoint open neighborhoods; separability asserts a countable dense subset.

declarations.name: Compactness and Connectedness in Topological Spaces
declarations.scope_summary: Open cover compactness, sequential compactness, path connectedness
declarations.statement_summary: Every open cover admits a finite subcover; connectedness forbids disjoint nonempty open partitions.

declarations.name: Net and Filter Convergence in Uniform Structures
declarations.scope_summary: Directed sets, nets, filter bases, and uniform continuity
declarations.statement_summary: Nets characterize closure and compactness in non-first-countable topological spaces.

declarations.name: Metric Completeness and Total Boundedness
declarations.statement_summary: A metric space is compact if and only if it is complete and totally bounded.

declarations.name: Baire Category Theorem for Complete Metric Spaces
declarations.statement_summary: The countable intersection of dense open subsets in a complete metric space is dense.

declarations.name: Normed Vector Spaces and Banach Completions
declarations.scope_summary: Normed vector spaces over R or C
declarations.statement_summary: A normed space is complete (Banach) if every Cauchy sequence has a convergent limit.

declarations.name: Inner Product Spaces and Hilbert Completeness
declarations.scope_summary: Inner product spaces over R or C
declarations.statement_summary: Cauchy-Schwarz inequality |<x,y>| <= ||x|| ||y||, parallelogram law, and Hilbert space completeness.

declarations.name: Continuous Function Spaces C(K) and C0(X)
declarations.scope_summary: Compact Hausdorff K or locally compact X under supremum norm
declarations.statement_summary: C(K) equipped with the uniform norm ||f||_infty = sup_{x in K} |f(x)| is a Banach space.

declarations.name: Lebesgue Spaces L^p(Omega, mu)
declarations.statement_summary: Riesz-Fischer theorem: L^p(Omega, mu) is complete with respect to the L^p norm.

declarations.name: Arzelà-Ascoli Equicontinuity Compactness Theorem
declarations.scope_summary: Equicontinuous subsets of C(K) for compact K
declarations.statement_summary: A subset of C(K) is relatively compact if and only if it is pointwise bounded and equicontinuous.

declarations.name: Riesz Lemma on Unit Ball Compactness Failure
declarations.statement_summary: The closed unit ball in a normed space X is compact if and only if X is finite-dimensional.

declarations.name: Weak Derivatives and Sobolev Space W^{k,p}
declarations.scope_summary: Distributions, test functions C_c^infty, weak derivatives in L^p
declarations.statement_summary: Weak derivative definition via integration by parts against smooth compactly supported test functions.
